workflowName: TICKET-099 | LIVE | 2 Live Gate + One-Shot Send
rolloutOrder: Apply and verify the TICKET-271 database migration.
Deploy and smoke-test the Ops UI/API commit.
Re-fetch this exact active workflow and stop if its version changed.
Rebuild the 14 validated operations from this plan and validateOnly again.
Apply the n8n changes atomically, validate the saved workflow and keep it active.
Run no-send fixtures first, then one explicitly approved real-case smoke test.

changes.intent: Read the managed pause metadata in addition to legacy paused/note fields.

replacementRules: A paused row remains blocked unless it is a complete TICKET-271 until_date pause.
A managed pause is due only when pause_until is valid and not later than nowUtc.
Legacy/AI pauses with null pause_mode or incomplete metadata never auto-resume.
The candidate carries expected pause_version and updated_at for optimistic resume.
Existing reply_restart and partial_payment cycle calculations remain unchanged.

changes.failureBehavior: Stop this execution before live customer checks or sending.

branches.true: Auto-Resume Due Managed Pause -> Shopify Complete Live Gate

changes.intent: Fetch zero or one exact dunning_status row immediately before the complete live gate.

changes.newPath: Read Current Dunning Hold -> Build Complete Live Gate + Message

replacementRules: Use only Read Current Dunning Hold for the final pause decision.
A failed request or more than one exact row adds MANUAL_HOLD_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE.
All existing payment, reply, stop-tag, dispute, refund, credit and schedule gates remain unchanged.

changes.node: DB Atomic Customer Claim No Upsert
changes.intent: Use the same per-case advisory lock as pause actions so a pause and an email claim cannot cross.

requiredFixtures.name: future managed pause
requiredFixtures.expected: No candidate and no customer send.

requiredFixtures.name: due managed pause
requiredFixtures.expected: Exactly one auto_resume audit event, then all existing live gates run.

requiredFixtures.name: legacy or AI pause
requiredFixtures.expected: No auto-resume and no customer send.

requiredFixtures.name: manual pause wins race
requiredFixtures.expected: The atomic email claim fails closed and no customer send occurs.

requiredFixtures.name: email claim wins race
requiredFixtures.expected: The pause request returns DUNNING_PAUSE_SEND_IN_PROGRESS instead of claiming success.

requiredFixtures.name: manual resume after stop or uncertain reply
requiredFixtures.expected: Existing reply_restart S1 cycle resumes after three business days.

requiredFixtures.name: partial payment
requiredFixtures.expected: Existing partial_payment S1 cycle continues for the remaining balance.

requiredFixtures.name: full payment, stop tag, refund, dispute or credit
requiredFixtures.expected: Existing fail-closed live gate still blocks the send after resume.
